about.title: About
about.heroSubtitle: Ein Schweizer Haus für Privatvermögen und qualifiziertes Unternehmenskapital.
about.sectionDescription: Swiss Bullion Depository Vault (SBDV) steht für absolute Sicherheit und Vertraulichkeit. Gegründet in der Schweiz — dem weltweiten Zentrum von Vertrauen und Diskretion — verbindet SBDV modernsten Schutz mit zeitloser Schweizer Präzision. Unsere Mission: zu bewahren, was am wichtigsten ist — Ihr Vermögen, Ihr Vermächtnis, Ihre Ruhe.
about.missionText: To preserve wealth and trust with Swiss precision, discretion, and integrity. We are committed to safeguarding not just assets, but the trust and peace of mind that comes with knowing your wealth is protected by the highest standards of Swiss excellence.
about.visionText: To be the world's most trusted private vault — a silent guardian for global investors. We envision a future where SBDV is recognized as the premier destination for those who demand uncompromising security, absolute discretion, and timeless reliability.
about.aboutParagraph1: Swiss Bullion Depository Vault (SBDV) stands as a bastion of absolute security and confidentiality. Founded in Switzerland — the global epicenter of trust and discretion — SBDV combines cutting-edge protection with timeless Swiss precision.
about.aboutParagraph2: Our mission is to preserve and secure what matters most: your wealth, your legacy, your peace of mind. We understand that true wealth protection requires more than just physical security—it demands absolute discretion, Swiss engineering excellence, and an unwavering commitment to integrity.
about.aboutParagraph3: Every aspect of our operation reflects Swiss values: precision in execution, discretion in all matters, and integrity in every interaction. We are not just a vault; we are a silent guardian, protecting what matters most to the world's most discerning clients.

legal.privacyIntro: Swiss Bullion Depository Vault (SBDV) complies with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP) and international privacy standards.
legal.privacyBody: We collect personal information solely for the purpose of providing vault custody, investment, and membership services. Data is processed with strict confidentiality, stored securely, and never sold to third parties. Clients may request access, correction, or deletion of their personal data by contacting our data protection officer.
legal.termsIntro: These terms govern your use of SBDV services and client portal.
legal.termsBody: By engaging SBDV services, you agree to comply with Swiss KYC and AML requirements. Vault custody, investment advisory, and portfolio management services are provided subject to separate service agreements. SBDV reserves the right to modify services with appropriate notice to clients.
legal.regulatoryIntro: Important information regarding our regulatory status and client protections.
legal.regulatoryBody: SBDV operates under Swiss financial security and privacy frameworks. Investment and portfolio management services may require appropriate licensing or be provided through regulated partners. All clients undergo KYC and AML screening. Risk disclosures: investments involve risk including possible loss of principal. Past performance is not indicative of future results.
legal.investorRelationsBody: SBDV is committed to transparency with our clients and stakeholders. Annual reports, governance policies, and institutional disclosures will be published here as they become available. For institutional inquiries, please contact our investor relations team through the contact page.
